Intraday Range Strategy — backtest

Rules tested

Range (09:20)Highest-volume 100-pt CE & PE strikes after the first 5-min candle. UPPER = CE leader + PE leader's first-candle high · LOWER = PE leader − CE leader's first-candle high. Entry09:20 — sell the 50-pt strike nearest UPPER (CE) and nearest LOWER (PE), 1 lot each, current-week expiry (expiry day included). Leader changeChecked every minute on cumulative day volume. New range from the new leaders' first-candle highs. Range up → book PE, sell PE nearest new LOWER. Range down → book CE, sell CE nearest new UPPER. Stop lossLoss (booked + open) reaches 50% of the 09:20 premium (collected 100 → exit at 150). No re-entry. Exit15:15. Fills at the next minute's open with 0.5 pt slippage per order. Charges: ₹20/order, STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp, GST.
